_meta.description: Market intelligence node registry. Dormant = registered, no code. Active = scout running. Template pattern from property-scout.
_meta.ground_truth_test: Is Paul actively checking this market? If no, it stays dormant. No agents producing output for nobody.

global-property.label: Global Property Markets (UK, Portugal, Japan, Dubai)
global-property.notes: Pulse data exists in global-pulse.json. No active scraping per-market yet.

gold.label: Gold (spot, coins, bars)
gold.notes: Store of value. Paul's DCA strategy could extend here.

watches.label: Luxury Watches (Rolex, Patek, AP)
watches.notes: Standardised models, tracked indices. Knight Frank category.

trading-cards.label: Trading Cards (Pokemon, Sports)
trading-cards.notes: Most mature collectible market — grading standard exists.

art.label: Art Market
art.notes: Illiquid. Long hold periods. Authentication risk.

handbags.label: Luxury Handbags (Hermès Birkin, Chanel)
handbags.notes: Birkin = best-performing luxury asset. Waitlist = artificial scarcity.

vintage-cars.label: Classic/Vintage Cars
vintage-cars.notes: Knight Frank category. High storage/maintenance cost.

coins-stamps.label: Coins & Stamps
coins-stamps.notes: Mature grading. Declining collector base for stamps.

gpu-hardware.label: GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD)
gpu-hardware.notes: Wildly cyclical — crypto/AI demand spikes. Resale value tracks compute demand.

ram-memory.label: RAM / Memory Modules
ram-memory.notes: Commodity with known supply cycles. Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron oligopoly.

apple-devices.label: Apple Devices (resale)
apple-devices.notes: Predictable depreciation curves. High resale vs Android.

server-hardware.label: Server / Enterprise Hardware
server-hardware.notes: AI boom = GPU server premium. Off-lease cycles.

domains.label: Domain Names
domains.notes: Mature market. .com premium. AI domains trending.

saas-businesses.label: SaaS Businesses & Websites
saas-businesses.notes: Revenue multiples. Recurring income. Due diligence heavy.

ip-licensing.label: IP / Content Licensing
ip-licensing.notes: Passive income from created assets. Stick Logan potential.

energy-oil.label: Crude Oil (WTI/Brent)
energy-oil.notes: Macro indicator. Not directly tradeable for Paul but context for everything else.

copper.label: Copper
copper.notes: Dr. Copper — economic health indicator. AI/electrification demand.

uranium.label: Uranium
uranium.notes: Nuclear renaissance thesis. Limited supply. Long-cycle.

cocoa.label: Cocoa
cocoa.notes: Supply crisis 2024-2026. West Africa concentration risk.

whisky.label: Whisky (Scotch, Japanese)
whisky.notes: Japanese whisky = fastest appreciating spirit. Knight Frank tracks.

lego.label: LEGO Sets (retired)
lego.notes: 12-15% avg annual return on retired sets (BrickEconomy data). Predictable retirement = predictable supply cut.

index-funds.label: Index Funds / ETFs (S&P 500, Hang Seng, etc.)
index-funds.notes: Paul's DCA findings suggest this as core strategy.

stablecoin-yield.label: Stablecoin Yield (USDC, USDT lending)
stablecoin-yield.notes: 4-8% on dollar-pegged. Mentioned in Paul's financial strategy.

hk-reits.label: HK REITs
hk-reits.notes: Property exposure without property. Paul's HK context.

real-estate.description: Physical property — residential, commercial, industrial, land

precious-metals.description: Store-of-value metals — gold, silver, platinum, palladium

collectibles.description: Passion assets — watches, wine, cards, art, sneakers, whisky, LEGO

tech-hardware.description: Computing hardware with resale cycles — GPUs, RAM, Apple, servers

digital-assets.description: Domains, SaaS businesses, IP licensing, digital products

commodities-energy.description: Oil, gas, uranium — macro context indicators

commodities-industrial.description: Copper, lithium, nickel — industrial demand proxies

commodities-agriculture.description: Coffee, cocoa, grains — climate and supply chain driven

financial.description: Stocks, bonds, crypto, index funds, stablecoin yield, REITs
